hebrewText: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְנֵ֣ר אֶל דָּוִ֡ד אָק֣וּמָה וְֽ/אֵלֵ֡כָה וְ/אֶקְבְּצָה֩ אֶל אֲדֹנִ֨/י הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְ/יִכְרְת֤וּ אִתְּ/ךָ֙ בְּרִ֔ית וּ/מָ֣לַכְתָּ֔ בְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר תְּאַוֶּ֖ה נַפְשֶׁ֑/ךָ וַ/יְּשַׁלַּ֥ח דָּוִ֛ד אֶת אַבְנֵ֖ר וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ בְּ/שָׁלֽוֹם

tokens.bdb: to say (used with great latitude)
tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, [phrase] (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, [idiom] desire, determine, [idiom] expressly, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] intend, name, [idiom] plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), [idiom] still, [idiom] suppose, talk, tell, term, [idiom] that is, [idiom] think, use (speech), utter, [idiom] verily, [idiom] yet.

tokens.bdb: Abner, an Israelite
tokens.kjv: Abner.

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).

tokens.bdb: David, the youngest son of Jesse
tokens.kjv: David.

tokens.bdb: to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)
tokens.kjv: abide, accomplish, [idiom] be clearer, confirm, continue, decree, [idiom] be dim, endure, [idiom] enemy, enjoin, get up, make good, help, hold, (help to) lift up (again), make, [idiom] but newly, ordain, perform, pitch, raise (up), rear (up), remain, (a-) rise (up) (again, against), rouse up, set (up), (e-) stablish, (make to) stand (up), stir up, strengthen, succeed, (as-, make) sure(-ly), (be) up(-hold, -rising).

tokens.bdb: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] again, away, bear, bring, carry (away), come (away), depart, flow, [phrase] follow(-ing), get (away, hence, him), (cause to, made) go (away, -ing, -ne, one's way, out), grow, lead (forth), let down, march, prosper, [phrase] pursue, cause to run, spread, take away (-journey), vanish, (cause to) walk(-ing), wax, [idiom] be weak.

tokens.bdb: to grasp, i.e. collect
tokens.kjv: assemble (selves), gather (bring) (together, selves together, up), heap, resort, [idiom] surely, take up.

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).

tokens.bdb: sovereign, i.e. controller (human or divine)
tokens.kjv: lord, master, owner. Compare also names beginning with 'Adoni-'.

tokens.bdb: a king
tokens.kjv: king, royal.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
tokens.kjv: Israel.

tokens.bdb: to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces)
tokens.kjv: be chewed, be con-(feder-) ate, covenant, cut (down, off), destroy, fail, feller, be freed, hew (down), make a league (covenant), [idiom] lose, perish, [idiom] utterly, [idiom] want.

tokens.bdb: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
tokens.kjv: against, among, before, by, for, from, in(-to), (out) of, with. Often with another prepositional prefix.

tokens.bdb: a compact (because made by passing between pieces of flesh)
tokens.kjv: confederacy, (con-) feder(-ate), covenant, league.

tokens.bdb: to reign; inceptively, to ascend the throne; causatively, to induct into royalty; hence (by implication) to take counsel
tokens.kjv: consult, [idiom] indeed, be (make, set a, set up) king, be (make) queen, (begin to, make to) reign(-ing), rule, [idiom] surely.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.

tokens.bdb: to wish for
tokens.kjv: covet, (greatly) desire, be desirous, long, lust (after).

tokens.bdb: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
tokens.kjv: any, appetite, beast, body, breath, creature, [idiom] dead(-ly), desire, [idiom] (dis-) contented, [idiom] fish, ghost, [phrase] greedy, he, heart(-y), (hath, [idiom] jeopardy of) life ([idiom] in jeopardy), lust, man, me, mind, mortally, one, own, person, pleasure, (her-, him-, my-, thy-) self, them (your) -selves, [phrase] slay, soul, [phrase] tablet, they, thing, ([idiom] she) will, [idiom] would have it.

tokens.bdb: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring (on the way), cast (away, out), conduct, [idiom] earnestly, forsake, give (up), grow long, lay, leave, let depart (down, go, loose), push away, put (away, forth, in, out), reach forth, send (away, forth, out), set, shoot (forth, out), sow, spread, stretch forth (out).

tokens.bdb: David, the youngest son of Jesse
tokens.kjv: David.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).

tokens.bdb: Abner, an Israelite
tokens.kjv: Abner.

tokens.bdb: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] again, away, bear, bring, carry (away), come (away), depart, flow, [phrase] follow(-ing), get (away, hence, him), (cause to, made) go (away, -ing, -ne, one's way, out), grow, lead (forth), let down, march, prosper, [phrase] pursue, cause to run, spread, take away (-journey), vanish, (cause to) walk(-ing), wax, [idiom] be weak.

tokens.bdb: safe, i.e. (figuratively) well, happy, friendly; also (abstractly) welfare, i.e. health, prosperity, peace
tokens.kjv: [idiom] do, familiar, [idiom] fare, favour, [phrase] friend, [idiom] great, (good) health, ([idiom] perfect, such as be at) peace(-able, -ably), prosper(-ity, -ous), rest, safe(-ty), salute, welfare, ([idiom] all is, be) well, [idiom] wholly.
